en.html:
Here. Here only!
The one perfectly safe place.

From that guard, Shishiku could hardly thrust downward. For a downward cut I would be a very convenient target—but that cut he could not deliver.

ja.html:
ここだ。
　ここが唯一、完璧な安全地帯！

　獅子吼の構から、下向きに<ruby>刺突<rt>つき</rt></ruby>を繰り出すのは無理
がある。
　斬り下ろすならば好餌だが――しかし、それは成し
得ないのだ。

en.html:
Even while sinking into the confusion his blade had made, I had just managed to follow his right hand. Quietly, it had left the sword... and gone to draw the short sword at his waist!

Jump upward, move sideways—probably he would have finished me with that short sword thrown at me. Very fine sword trick. Very fine check on the king.

Only, one escape he had left. Down.
Throw at me crouching here, and the short sword would hit my helmet. Whatever cleverness was in his hands, the gap at my throat could not be pierced. No line of fire was there. Cleverness would have to manage without one.

ja.html:
眩惑の沼に落とされゆく<ruby>最中<rt>さなか</rt></ruby>、俺の眼は辛うじて、
獅子吼の右手の行方を追っていた。
　それは密かに、太刀から外され……腰の脇差を引き
抜こうとしていた……！

　上へ飛ぼうと左右へ身を振ろうと、おそらく獅子吼
は脇差の投擲によって俺を仕留めたであろう。
　見事な妖剣、見事な<ruby>王手<rt>チェック</rt></ruby>だ。

　が、唯一。下方にのみ退路を残した。
　しゃがみ込んだ俺に向かって脇差を投げても、兜に
当たるだけだ。いかに巧妙な手業があろうと、喉元の
間隙を穿つ事はできない。<ruby>射線<rt>・・</rt></ruby>が通らないのだから。

en.html: As for cutting down, his long sword was now in his left hand alone. A one-handed cut could not possibly break through the armor. The advantage—◆now changed sides!
en.text:
As for cutting down, his long sword was now in his left hand alone. A one-handed cut could not possibly break through the armor.

The advantage—◆now changed sides!

ja.html: 斬り下ろそうにも、獅子吼の長刀は今、左手一本で 保持されている。 　片手斬りでは到底、甲鉄を打ち破るなど叶わない。 　形勢の優劣は――――◆今、転じた！
ja.text:
斬り下ろそうにも、獅子吼の長刀は今、左手一本で
保持されている。
　片手斬りでは到底、甲鉄を打ち破るなど叶わない。

　形勢の優劣は――――◆今、転じた！

en.html:
Away went his short sword. Both hands returned to the long one, and down came the blow—

But now I was faster!
en.text:
Away went his short sword. Both hands returned to the long one, and down came the blow—

But now I was faster!

ja.html:
獅子吼が脇差を捨てる。
　太刀を両手に取り直し、上から襲う一撃――

　しかし、俺の方が早い!!
